title: Threshold and brightness
hints: Compare energy per photon with the work function.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Individual photons remain below $\Phi$, so there is no photoelectron emission.
statement:
A beam lies below a metal’s threshold frequency. What happens when it is made brighter in the usual one-photon model?

[_]{a}

explanations: The photons still cannot eject an electron.
The threshold is a property of the surface.
